lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Servant, rejoice!

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: At long last, a pair of gloves have appeared,

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: allowing machines to withstand my touch!
Congratulations

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Congratulations?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: It sounds like this is news to you.
Is it not?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: If you were planning on a surprise, you can give up now.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: The cat is already out of the bag.
I really didn't send it.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: You really didn't send these gloves?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Well, this is rather unexpected.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: I was certain it was you.
Are you saying you don't know who sent you the gloves?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: I received a package in the mail a few days ago.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Inside were these mysterious gloves

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: and a note saying,

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: "For the sake of countless cuties in this world."

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: I'm not sure what cuties they're referring to,

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: but at the very least, it seems that

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: they're familiar with what my body is capable of.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: So I thought it was you who sent it.
For the sake of countless cuties...

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Yes, that's what is written on the note.

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: you've taken to calling Nikkes cuties now?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: A lot has changed since I was here last.
You've got the wrong idea!

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: Have I?

lines.speaker: ludmilla
lines.text: fhslhslfkj

Did it break again?
There is no further response.
Looks like Ludmilla has broken yet another device.
I'll have to explain the whole "cutie" misunderstanding with her later.
